note: Machine-readable timeline for demo-video-v4.html. Each scene has start/end in seconds, the HTML element id it activates (sceneEl), the URL displayed in the browser frame, and bilingual narration (zh/en) with placeholder audio/video paths.

scenes.zh: 量子實驗室開機,觀測者進場。
scenes.en: The quantum laboratory boots up. The observer enters.

scenes.zh: 海森堡的算盤 — 把市場調查當作量子觀測,N=30 位虛擬受訪者並行作答。
scenes.en: Heisenberg's Abacus — market research as quantum observation, N=30 synthetic respondents answering in parallel.

scenes.zh: 一鍵以 demo admin 進場,觀測者身份確認。
scenes.en: One-click demo admin login. Observer identity confirmed.

scenes.zh: 主介面三張產品範例卡片,可直接點或自訂命題。
scenes.en: Three product templates on the main screen — or type any prompt of your own.

scenes.zh: 平台抽樣自 60 位合成虛擬人格 — v1 外送員 30 位、v2 上班族 30 位,每個都有獨立的家庭、收入、人格五維。
scenes.en: The platform draws from 60 synthetic personas — 30 delivery riders (v1), 30 office workers (v2). Each one has its own family, income, and five-dimensional personality.

scenes.zh: 我們示範一個年費 990 元、保額 200 萬的旅遊保險信用卡,目標 30-45 歲族群。
scenes.en: We pitch a travel-insurance credit card: NT$990 per year, NT$2M coverage, targeting ages 30 to 45.

scenes.zh: 送出觀測,五段管線啟動 — 啟動者結構化、觀測者規劃 4-6 題訪談。
scenes.en: Submit. The five-stage pipeline lights up — the entry agent structures the brief, the PM agent designs 4 to 6 interview questions.

scenes.zh: 30 位 persona 並行 streaming 答題,concurrency 6、bundled JSON 一通 N 題。
scenes.en: 30 personas answer in parallel — concurrency 6, bundled JSON, one call per persona covers every question.

scenes.zh: 第二題保額 200 萬夠不夠 — 6 位代表立場各異,從「勉強夠」「太低」到「家庭出遊不夠」。
scenes.en: Question 2: is NT$2M coverage enough? Six voices, six positions — barely enough, too low, not for family travel.

scenes.zh: 翻頁繼續看 Q3 年費敏感度、Q4 競品比較 — 同樣 30 位受訪者橫向掃描。
scenes.en: Page to Q3 on annual-fee sensitivity, Q4 on competitor comparison — the same 30 respondents scanned horizontally.

scenes.zh: 行為相變散布圖誕生 — 30 顆粒子分布在拒絕 / 觀望 / 購買三區,KPI 同步顯示 38 / 34 / 28%。
scenes.en: The behavioural phase-transition map appears — 30 particles spread across reject, watch, buy zones; KPIs read 38 / 34 / 28%.

scenes.zh: Hover 任何粒子看到受訪者背景、五維分數;族群結構即時量化。
scenes.en: Hover any particle for the respondent's background and five-dimensional score. Segment structure quantified in real time.

scenes.zh: 進模擬艙 — 算盤滑桿掌控年費 / 保額 / 回饋率三條主軸,外加通膨、失業兩個外部衝擊。
scenes.en: Enter the simulation lab — the abacus slider controls annual fee, coverage, rebate, plus inflation and unemployment shocks.

scenes.zh: 年費從 990 拉到 490,粒子重新塌縮,購買率 38% 跳到 67% — 假設驗證從兩週縮到兩秒。
scenes.en: Drag the annual fee from 990 to 490. Particles re-collapse, buy rate jumps from 38% to 67%. Hypothesis testing in two seconds.

scenes.zh: 三層決策桑基:語意脈絡 → 行為誘因 → 決策,動機差異一條條 ribbon 攤開,直接看到「保額不足 → 觀望」族群在哪。
scenes.en: A three-tier decision Sankey: semantic context → behavioural triggers → decision. Motivation differences unfold as ribbons. The low-coverage → watch segment is right there.

scenes.zh: 完整決策報告降下:Headline、KPI、四項關鍵發現、族群比較表、行動建議。
scenes.en: The full decision report descends: headline, KPIs, four key findings, segment comparison table, action items.

scenes.zh: 一鍵下載 PDF 或寄到信箱,或直接跳回模擬艙微調 — 交付物不再是逐字稿與簡報。
scenes.en: One click to download the PDF, email it, or jump back to the simulation lab. The deliverable is no longer a transcript or a slide deck.

scenes.zh: 不只金融商品 — 我換個題目:幫我規劃滷肉飯口味洋芋片餅乾的市調。
scenes.en: Beyond financial products — let's switch topics. Help me design a market study for a braised-pork-rice flavoured potato chip cracker.

scenes.zh: 商品規格:跟知名滷肉飯聯名、102 克售價 49 元、香脆鹹甜醬油風味、試水溫。
scenes.en: Product spec: co-branded with a famous braised-pork-rice brand, 102g at NT$49, crispy, savoury soy-sauce flavour, testing the waters.

scenes.zh: 30 位受訪者 87 秒給回應:試吃意願 78%、願意付 49 元 52%、期望售價 35 到 55 元、獵奇加分 11pp。
scenes.en: 30 respondents, 87 seconds: 78% willing to taste, 52% accept the NT$49 price, expected price range NT$35-55, novelty adds 11 percentage points.

scenes.zh: 系統架構:Next.js 14 前端 + Anthropic SDK 串 MiniMax-M2.5,5 段管線、6 個 Claude agent 接力,全域 semaphore + bundled JSON 維持 0 個 429。
scenes.en: System architecture: Next.js 14 frontend, Anthropic SDK pointing at MiniMax-M2.5, five-stage pipeline with six Claude agents in relay, global semaphore plus bundled JSON keeps 429 errors at zero.

scenes.zh: 把市場調查從 14 天、30-50 萬、PII 風險,壓縮成 90 秒、零真人資料、邊際成本趨近零。
scenes.en: Compress market research from 14 days, NT$300-500K budget, and PII risk — into 90 seconds, zero real-person data, near-zero marginal cost.

scenes.zh: 不再訪問消費者 — 召喚機率雲。
scenes.en: Stop interviewing consumers — summon the probability cloud.

scenes.zh: 海森堡的算盤,Built with Claude Code · MiniMax-M2.5 · Next.js 14。
scenes.en: Heisenberg's Abacus. Built with Claude Code, MiniMax-M2.5, Next.js 14.
